from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, signal, statistics, subprocess, sys, time

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('phase', choices=['screen', 'full', 'regression'])
args = parser.parse_args()
root = Path.cwd()
task = root / '.local/tool-tasks/shuffle-card-value-call-20261009'
previous = root / '.local/tool-tasks/pile-hook-projection-20261009'
baseline = task.parent / 'nonempty-pile-callback-contract-20261009/build-final/CombatSolver.dll'
candidate = task / 'build-candidate/CombatSolver.dll'
roots = ['silent-large-deck', 'dev-08-regent-boss'] if args.phase == 'screen' else ['silent-large-deck', 'screen-huge-deck', 'dev-08-regent-boss']
if args.phase == 'regression':
    roots = sorted(p.name for p in (previous / 'hardened-regression').iterdir() if p.is_dir())
order = ['C1'] if args.phase == 'regression' else ['A1', 'C1', 'C2', 'A2']
removed = sorted(k for k in os.environ if k.startswith(('COMPlus_Jit', 'DOTNET_Jit')) or k in ['PILE_PROJECTION_PROBE_OUTPUT', 'PROJECTED_LISTENER_PROBE_OUTPUT', 'COMBATSOLVER_VERIFY_HISTORY_COUNTERS'])
plan = {'phase': args.phase, 'roots': roots, 'order': order, 'baselineSha256': hashlib.sha256(baseline.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'candidateSha256': hashlib.sha256(candidate.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'outerTimeoutSeconds': 120, 'removedEnvironmentKeys': removed, 'diagnosticInstrumentation': False, 'sourceBase': 'd6e746a1', 'screenAdvanceRule': 'all quality/root/live/policy/budget guards pass; target median speedup >= 1.02; maximum candidate RSS / minimum control RSS <= 1.10'}
(task / (args.phase + '-plan.json')).write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + '\n')
rows = []
groups = []
for name in roots:
    directory = previous / ('hardened-full' if name in ['silent-large-deck', 'screen-huge-deck', 'dev-08-regent-boss'] else 'hardened-regression') / name / 'C1'
    ac = json.loads((directory / 'command.json').read_text())
    reference = None
    group = []
    if args.phase == 'regression':
        reference = directory
    for label in order:
        out = task / args.phase / name / label
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        cmd = list(ac['command'])
        cmd[cmd.index('--out') + 1] = str(out)
        cmd[cmd.index('--label') + 1] = 'shuffle-card-value-call-' + args.phase + '-' + name + '-' + label
        if args.phase == 'screen':
            cmd[cmd.index('--search-mode') + 1] = 'Evaluate'
            cmd[cmd.index('--nodes') + 1] = '25000'
            cmd[cmd.index('--budget-ms') + 1] = '60000'
            cmd.remove('--use-portfolio')
            cmd.remove('--production-budget')
        dll = baseline if label.startswith('A') else candidate
        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in removed}
        env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL'] = str(dll)
        (out / 'command.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command': cmd, 'environmentOverrides': {'OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL': str(dll)}, 'requestSha256': ac['requestSha256'], 'hostSha256': ac['hostSha256'], 'dllSha256': hashlib.sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'outerTimeoutSeconds': 120, 'noProfilerOrCorrectnessInstrumentation': True}, indent=2) + '\n')
        started = time.monotonic()
        with (out / 'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
            proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
            try:
                code = proc.wait(timeout=120)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                proc.wait()
                code = 124
        row = {'root': name, 'label': label, 'exitCode': code, 'processWallSeconds': time.monotonic() - started}
        if (out / 'result.json').exists():
            if reference is None:
                reference = out
            r = json.loads((out / 'result.json').read_text())
            a = json.loads((reference / 'result.json').read_text())
            h = json.loads((out / 'harness-result.json').read_text())
            ah = json.loads((reference / 'harness-result.json').read_text())
            keys = ['totalExpanded', 'totalTransitions', 'totalChoiceBranches', 'maxParallelConcurrency']
            quality_keys = ['score', 'projectedBattleHpLost', 'potionCount', 'onlyDeathRoutes', 'finalHp', 'finalEnemyHp', 'combatEndedTurn', 'searchedTurns', 'shufflesCrossed', 'unavoidableHpLost', 'potionUses']
            quality = r['comparisonQuality'] if r['comparisonQuality'] is not None else {k: r['solverMetrics'].get(k) for k in quality_keys}
            control_quality = a['comparisonQuality'] if a['comparisonQuality'] is not None else {k: a['solverMetrics'].get(k) for k in quality_keys}
            row.update({'status': r['status'], 'timeBoundaryObserved': r['timeBoundaryObserved'], 'wallSeconds': r['wallSeconds'], 'peakProcessWorkingSetBytes': r['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'], 'quality': quality, 'qualityScope': '14 complete coordinator fields' if r['comparisonQuality'] is not None else '11 evaluate fields; complete coordinator quality not available', 'qualityEqual': quality == control_quality, 'rootEqual': r['rootContinuationStamp'] == a['rootContinuationStamp'], 'liveEqual': h['search']['rootLiveStamp'] == ah['search']['rootLiveStamp'], 'budgetEqual': r['budget'] == a['budget'], 'policyEqual': json.loads((out / 'search-policy.json').read_text()) == json.loads((reference / 'search-policy.json').read_text()), 'work': {k: r['solverMetrics'].get(k) for k in keys}, 'controlWork': {k: a['solverMetrics'].get(k) for k in keys}, 'reference': str(reference)})
            row['workEqual'] = row['work'] == row['controlWork']
        rows.append(row)
        group.append(row)
        (task / (args.phase + '-runs.json')).write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + '\n')
        print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
        if code or row.get('status') != 'Passed' or row.get('timeBoundaryObserved') or not all(row.get(k) for k in ['qualityEqual', 'rootEqual', 'liveEqual', 'policyEqual', 'budgetEqual']):
            sys.exit(1)
    if args.phase != 'regression':
        aa = [r for r in group if r['label'].startswith('A')]
        cc = [r for r in group if r['label'].startswith('C')]
        summary = {'root': name, 'medianSpeedup': statistics.median(r['wallSeconds'] for r in aa) / statistics.median(r['wallSeconds'] for r in cc), 'maximumCandidateRssOverMinimumControl': max(r['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for r in cc) / min(r['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for r in aa), 'samples': group}
        groups.append(summary)
        (task / (args.phase + '-groups.json')).write_text(json.dumps(groups, indent=2) + '\n')
        print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in summary.items() if k != 'samples'}), flush=True)
        if summary['maximumCandidateRssOverMinimumControl'] > 1.10:
            sys.exit(1)
